title: Calibration Procedure Fee Rate Card, Calibration Workmanship Warranty
content:
**Rate.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, the calibration diagnostic charge posted on a calibration fault found not covered under a Calibration Workmanship Warranty is built on the calibration procedure fee. The calibration procedure fee follows the procedure the manufacturer specifies on the calibration order the coverage was issued on, that is, the source order held under ADAS Sensor Calibrations:

| Manufacturer procedure on the source calibration order | Calibration procedure fee |
|---|---|
| Both the static and the dynamic procedure | the dual-procedure fee, USD 109.95 |
| The dynamic procedure alone | the dynamic-procedure fee, USD 94.95 |
| The static procedure alone, or neither | the plan's standard diagnostic fee |

## Notes to the card

- **Which order.** Only the calibration order the coverage was issued on is read, not any later calibration order on the vehicle.
- **What is read.** The manufacturer procedure entered on that ADAS Sensor Calibrations order: static, dynamic, or static and dynamic.
- **Neither procedure.** An order that calls for neither procedure is treated as the static-alone case: the calibration procedure fee is the plan's standard diagnostic fee.

## Hypothetical readings

| Source order (hypothetical) | Calibration procedure fee |
|---|---|
| Dual-mode camera order calling for static and dynamic procedures | USD 109.95 |
| Dynamic camera order calling for the dynamic procedure | USD 94.95 |
| Static camera order calling for the static procedure | the plan's standard diagnostic fee |
